expected_deliverable: A narrow provider-free persistent dispatcher implementation with durable lifecycle evidence, current-state prompt classification, indefinite exact-once queue semantics, recovery restart/adoption, and deterministic race coverage.

busy supervisor defers and later idle transition delivers once

objective: Implement the smallest repository-local provider-free host dispatcher that persists independently of Runner and supervisor tool turns, observes durable terminal wake requests, evaluates the current authoritative tmux supervisor immediately before delivery without a launch-time readiness lease, queues indefinitely while unsafe or unavailable, and delivers and consumes each event exactly once after safe prompt-idle or later recovery.
operator_policy_constraints: Codex enabled with configured model and reasoning effort
prohibited_actions: blind tmux injection or optimistic composer inference
finite queue TTL or deletion of undelivered terminal requests
one dispatcher per event or multiple unfenced dispatcher owners
model polling, heartbeat-triggered inference, or supervisor wait cells
rewriting failed live evidence, broad refactoring, release, deployment, merge, push, or global installation
relevant_context: Immutable live timing shows CHILD_COMPLETION at 23:54:36.916Z, HOST_WAKE_QUEUED at 23:54:36.931Z, and HOST_WAKE_DEFERRED at 23:54:41.776Z with ambiguous-composer. The initial delivery attempt was prompt; the architectural defect is that the five-second adapter then exited and nothing remained to observe a later safe-idle transition.
The current readiness lease was asserted at child launch and is now expired. Prompt safety must instead be derived conservatively from current host evidence immediately before each delivery attempt.

The authoritative Codex supervisor runs persistently in tmux. A detached repository-local Node dispatcher is permitted; external GUI, container, distributed service, server-wide installation, and model inference are not.
The dispatcher must not wake on heartbeat or nonterminal progress. Only terminal completion/failure/timeout/stall/intervention requests already admitted by enqueueTerminalWake are eligible.

When no queued requests exist, wait on filesystem/event notification without model activity. While a request is queued but the host is unsafe, provider-free re-evaluation may use a conservative bounded backoff and must not expire or discard the request.

Safe prompt-idle must require an authoritative live session/pane/Codex process, no attached human client, a directly observed empty Codex composer and idle prompt, and an immediate tmux server-side final predicate before literal paste plus Enter.
Busy Codex, attached human interaction, nonempty human composer text, unavailable tmux, ambiguous capture, and stale generation must all defer without input.

A dispatcher must be single-owner and generation-fenced. Recovery adopts receipt-free queued requests, retires or supersedes stale dispatchers, starts the current dispatcher, and later consumes a delivered event once.
A CLAIMED or UNCERTAIN delivery receipt remains non-replayable. DELIVERED and CONSUMED are idempotent duplicates.
Preserve the default detached Runner, explicit foreground fallback, zero wait-induced activations, Codex enabled, Claude disabled, review off, Gearbox required, and Context Firewall required.
scope: persistent detached host dispatcher lifecycle and generation fencing
immediate tmux prompt-idle, busy, human-typing, and unavailable classification
indefinite durable terminal-event queue and exact-once delivery
focused race tests and operator documentation
title: Replace finite wake adapter with persistent safe dispatcher
